m6-conf.title: Conference schedule (Easy)
m6-conf.html:
Conference schedule

A one-day conference has two halls, Hall 1 and Hall 2, and three time slots, Slot 1, Slot 2 and Slot 3, in that order. Six speakers — Anand, Bina, Chen, Divya, Elan and Farah — give one talk each, so that each hall has exactly one talk in each slot. Each talk belongs to one of three tracks — Data, Policy or Health — and there are exactly two talks in each track.

The following is known:

  • In each hall, the three talks are on three different tracks.
  • Anand speaks in the slot immediately after Bina's, and not in the hall in which Bina speaks.
  • Chen and Divya speak on the same track; Anand and Bina also speak on the same track.
  • Elan speaks in an earlier slot than Farah, and Divya in an earlier slot than Chen.
  • Elan's talk is on Data and is in Hall 2.
  • Neither talk in Slot 1 is on Policy, and Divya does not speak in Slot 1.

m6-bus.title: Bus roads (Medium)
m6-bus.html:
Bus roads

A bus company runs services between five towns: Hosur, Itarsi, Jhansi, Kolar and Latur. There are exactly seven roads between them, listed below; each road can be used in either direction, and each takes a whole number of minutes. Some road times are hidden.

RoadTime (minutes)
Hosur – Itarsi15
Hosur – Jhansi?
Itarsi – Jhansi10
Itarsi – Kolar?
Jhansi – Kolar?
Jhansi – Latur?
Kolar – Latur15

The quickest time between two towns is the least total time over any sequence of roads joining them (no waiting). Some quickest times are given below.

BetweenQuickest time (minutes)
Hosur and Jhansi20
Hosur and Kolar40
Hosur and Latur55
Itarsi and Latur40
Jhansi and Latur40

The following is also known:

  • The seven road times add up to 155 minutes.
  • The Itarsi – Kolar road and the Jhansi – Kolar road take the same time.

m6-shuttle.title: Airport shuttle (Medium)
m6-shuttle.html:
Airport shuttle

A shuttle made one trip from Stop 1 to Stop 6, calling at every stop in order. It was empty when it reached Stop 1 and empty after Stop 6. At each stop, passengers first got off and then others boarded; nobody got off at the stop where they boarded. The fare was ₹10 for every stop-to-stop segment travelled (for example, ₹30 from Stop 2 to Stop 5). The table shows how many passengers boarded and got off at each stop; some entries are hidden.

Stop 1Stop 2Stop 3Stop 4Stop 5Stop 6
Boarded158?4?–
Got off–410?8?

The following is known:

  • The total fare collected on the trip was ₹1,040.
  • The shuttle carried 30 passengers between Stop 3 and Stop 4, and fewer than 30 on every other segment.
  • It carried 4 fewer passengers between Stop 5 and Stop 6 than between Stop 4 and Stop 5.

m6-league.title: Four-team hockey league (Hard)
m6-league.html:
Four-team hockey league

Four hockey teams — Ajmer, Bokaro, Cuttack and Dhule — played a league in which each pair of teams met exactly once. A win earned 3 points, a draw 1 point and a loss 0. The table shows the goals each team scored and conceded over its three matches; two entries are hidden.

Goals scoredGoals conceded
Ajmer34
Bokaro64
Cuttack2?
Dhule?3

The following is known:

  • All four teams finished with the same number of points.
  • No match ended 0–0.
  • Ajmer won exactly one match, and won it by a margin of exactly one goal.

m6-ratings.title: Film festival scores (Hard)
m6-ratings.html:
Film festival scores

Four critics — W, X, Y and Z — each scored five films — Aranya, Bhor, Chitra, Dhoop and Ekant — at a festival. Each critic gave the scores 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 exactly once, one score to each film (5 is the best). The total score of each film is shown.

FilmAranyaBhorChitraDhoopEkant
Total score141312138

The following is known:

  • The four critics gave their scores of 5 to four different films.
  • W gave Aranya a higher score than each of the other three critics did.
  • Y gave Ekant a lower score than each of the other three critics did.
  • X gave Chitra a score of 2, and Z gave Dhoop a score of 5.
  • Y gave Bhor a higher score than Dhoop.
